body:
Grace and I are looking forward to returning to Africa in late May – Rwanda and Burundi. We’ll be with our good friends in amahoro-africa.org .

I described our time there last year in this post .

Maybe you should join us? Or if you can’t come, consider sponsoring an African participant … you’ll find information here .
